title: rosa acicularis var. subalpina
intro: Rosa acicularis var. subalpina, commonly known as the subalpine prickly rose, is a type of deciduous shrub native to North America. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, contributing to its use in treating various health issues. The subalpine prickly rose is said to have therapeutic actions such as reducing pain and inflammation, and its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, are believed to contribute to its health benefits. Further research is needed to fully understand the effects and potential uses of Rosa acicularis var. subalpina.
